snippet.title: BALLS TO THE WALLS - Incremental Physics Game - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5027780/Balls_to_the_Walls/
itch.io Demo: https://noahreeves.itch.io/balls-to-the-walls-demo

A short incremental physics game about upgrading and annihilating your balls. Equip chaotic special balls and buy physics-altering upgrades to break the simulation and get rich.
